title: $top is bounded 1–200, and the API's own hint says so
claim: A `$top` outside 1–200 is refused with INVALID_PARAMETER, and the refusal states the real bounds — maximum 200 in the text, default 50 in the hint — contradicting the official docs' claimed default of 40.

entries.text: One over the maximum. The refusal itself is where the true bounds come from.

errors.text: '$top' must be less than or equal to the maximum result size for this end point: 200
errors.hint: If no '$top' parameter is specified, a default top size of 50 will be used.

entries.text: Zero is out of range on the other side.
